# openinfra_static_site (Resource)

Static frontend hosting for a built SPA — the S3-static-website + CDN-origin-shaped primitive. Provisions a MinIO bucket (upload your dist/ via the emitted `<name>-minio` secret) and serves it over an nginx + Traefik Ingress with SPA history-fallback and cert-manager TLS.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Hostname the site is served on, e.g. `app.example.com`.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) MinIO bucket holding the built assets. Defaults to `<name>-site`; created if absent.
- `error_document` (String) Document served for 404s when `spa` is false (e.g. `404.html`).
- `index_document` (String) The index/entry document served at `/`.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `spa` (Boolean) Single-page-app history fallback: serve the index document for unknown paths.
- `sync_interval_seconds` (Number) How often the server re-syncs the bucket to pick up new uploads.
- `tls` (Boolean) Terminate TLS via cert-manager (openinfra-issuer). Set false for plain HTTP.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
